Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps that took longer to complete than our original schedule allowed, and this has pushed the delivery date back by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team has already accounted for this change in the remaining workplan, and all other project milestones will proceed on the adjusted schedule without further impact to scope or quality.

Would 14 April still work well for your internal planning and any downstream launch activities on your side? Please let us know if you'd like to discuss the revised timeline in more detail, and we'll be happy to set up a call.
